subject: Subprocessor onboarding timeline & egress telemetry ask
messages:
From: Suzanne Nguyen <suzanne.nguyen@cardio.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@cardio.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Subprocessor onboarding timeline & egress telemetry ask

Hi Irene,

We're preparing for a tight go‑live and need clarification on two items before we sign the DPA addendum:

1) NimbusEdge onboarding: CardioAI expects the APAC subprocessor (NimbusEdge) to be live and reachable no later than mid‑June. Can you share the realistic onboarding milestones (contract signature, background checks, IP/terms, SOC2 evidence) and a proposed activation date?

2) Transient egress telemetry: Our security team requires deterministic evidence for any cross‑border transient egress that may occur during failover windows. Specifically, we need: per‑request timestamps showing region origin and egress hop, KMS key IDs used for encryption at the time of the hop, and a retention window for these telemetry records (we prefer 90 days).

I've attached our current subprocessor roster for reference.

Attachments: [Attachment: Cardio_Subprocessor_Roster.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

Thanks — Suzanne
Suzanne Nguyen
Head of Security, CardioAI
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Nguyen <suzanne.nguyen@cardio.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding timeline & egress telemetry ask

Hi Suzanne — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, details below:

- Onboarding: We can target an activation in the 2nd week of June but need a signed subprocessor addendum + completion of our standard onboarding checklist to lock dates. Tentative target: 2027-06-15 for activation (conditional).

- Telemetry: Redwood can provide per‑request telemetry that includes: request_id, timestamp (UTC), ingress region, egress region (if a transient hop occurs), and KMS key id used for the data encryption context. Retention is configurable — our standard retention for operational telemetry is 90 days; we can commit to 90 days for CardioAI in a DPA addendum.

Notes and items we need from you:
- Confirmation that CardioAI accepts a planned activation date of 2027-06-15 (we'll build the runbook and schedule pre‑go tests).
- Any special retention or access controls beyond 90 days.
- Whether you need per‑token telemetry (very high cardinality, increases cost) or per‑request only (default).

I've attached our pinning/failover runbook excerpt and pasted a couple of relevant lines below. Legal will need to sign the subprocessor addendum — looping Ben for procurement and Marissa for compliance scheduling.

--- excerpt from pinning-failover-playbook.pdf ---
Transient egress is limited to failover scenarios where regional capacity or latency SLOs cannot be met within the pinned region. Failover windows are operationally constrained to the minimal duration required to complete requests; operators will notify customers via the notification channel and provide telemetry dump within 72 hours.

Attachments: [Attachment: pinning-failover-playbook.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Nguyen <suzanne.nguyen@cardio.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T14:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding timeline & egress telemetry ask

Thanks, Irene and Suzanne — tagging the schedule and operational checklist so we can commit to dates. High‑level onboarding timeline for NimbusEdge (APAC):

Week 0 (contracting): receive signed subprocessor addendum + SOW (DocuSign link below).
Week 1–2 (due diligence): background checks, security questionnaire completion, references.
Week 3–4 (technical onboarding): test keys and connectivity, run synthetic traffic, validate KV cache behavior for APAC routing.
> Pre‑go security review and a strike‑through of any outstanding issues — expected 2 business days.
Week 5 (go/no‑go): schedule activation, final smoke tests in staging.

Proposed firm activation date: 2027‑06‑15 (to allow buffer for legal and the SOC2 evidence share). If CardioAI needs acceleration, we can compress to 2027‑06‑08 but will require priority approvals and a 48‑hour pre‑activation blackout for production traffic.

Telemetry granularity: per‑request telemetry is our recommended default (request_id + timestamp + ingress/egress region + ksm:kms_key_id). Per‑token telemetry is possible but it is expensive and we generally avoid it unless the compliance team explicitly requires it. Please confirm which you prefer.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ABCDEF-12345
Attachment: [Attachment: NimbusEdge-Subprocessor-Overview.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Suzanne Nguyen <suzanne.nguyen@cardio.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@cardio.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding timeline & egress telemetry ask

Irene / Marissa — thanks for the speedy responses.

CardioAI accepts the 2027‑06‑15 activation date. We prefer per‑request telemetry (not per‑token) and confirm the 90‑day retention. Two final asks before we finalize the addendum:

1) Please provide a 30‑day pre‑activation notice in writing once DocuSign is fully executed so our platform team can schedule end‑to‑end validation.
2) In the (unlikely) event of an emergency cross‑region failover, CardioAI requires notification within 2 hours of detection and a telemetry export delivered within 72 hours. Your runbook language above is acceptable if you can commit to the 2‑hour notification SLA in the addendum.

Attachment: [Attachment: internal-security-acceptance.txt (txt, 3KB)]
